catalog.method: GET fixed URL; strip spaces/newlines; Base64 -> modified XXTEA (delta 0x9E5729B1, 7-char format key) -> JSON UTF-8
catalog.notes: Same cipher/key as RJC TUNNEL PRO (RJC-6) and Mx Tunnel PRO; only the catalog repo differs (RJCTUNNEL vs RJCPRO). Embedded gremlin.json is byte-for-byte the same as RJC-6's. rjc:// appears once as discarded dead code; no text decoder delivered.

files.method: lowercase hex -> repeated XOR with 12-byte key -> JNI modified UTF-8 -> JSON; protections checked after decryption
files.notes: Key verified against RJC-19's own libputils.so (arm64 split, .rodata 0xc505e); round-trip 6/6; asset server.psi recovers 22/23 valid JSON objects with this key. No real .rjc from a phone yet.
